text:
Nina (People Ops): Quick update — rolling out a 'lean evidence' lane for the upcoming SOC2/ISO collection. Purpose: reduce friction for small teams and contractors who only have a minimal artifact set. Sign-ups open now. :sparkles:

Omar (Compliance): The lean lane accepts a reduced checklist (IAM snapshot, 1 change ticket, training attestation). If you have more artifacts, use the regular lane. Mark uploads with `lean_` prefix.

Jae (Eng): Nice. My team only has the basics — will the lean lane still require the retention excerpt?

Omar (Compliance): Not if you're using the lean lane — retention excerpt is waived for teams with no PHI/PII flows. But you must confirm that on the form (checkbox) and link to the system inventory entry.

Rosa (Security): Teams with infra that touches customer data can't use lean lane. If in doubt, check the data-class column in the systems registry or ping me.

Nina (People Ops): Process: pick a 90-minute slot, upload via presigned URL, attach the short metadata form. There's also a contractor-only 60-minute lane (redaction required). Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/teams/compliance/lean-evidence (SSO).

DevBot: Reminder bot will DM leads 48h and 3h before their slot. React with :bell: to subscribe.

Jae (Eng): If we later find we need to add the retention doc, can we append?

Omar (Compliance): Yes — you can upload supplemental files using the same presigned link until the lane closes. Add a note in the form so reviewers see it's supplemental.

Nina (People Ops): Final cutoff for lean lane uploads is Thursday 5pm. After that, any missing items require an exception form (takes ~2 business days). Leads: please sign up today. :memo:
